description: Fixes applied from a 4-subagent adversarial review of the implementation
confirmed_bugs_fixed: BE: _build_faq_processor_from_index omitted setting_id/embedding_model/cron_expression -> private-repo edit-with-reindex cloned anonymously (data-wipe risk)
BE: IndexInfo.update_index silently dropped faq_path -> source edits were no-ops after ES wipe

BE: get_index_identifier computed {project}-{name}-llm_routing_faq while the processor writes {project}-{name} -> delete/stale-sweep/stats targeted a nonexistent index; private FAQ content never deleted from ES
BE: project move (new_project_name) allowed without full_reindex and never reindexed llm_routing indexes -> orphaned ES + broken retrieval
BE: _add_texts called len() on an int (stats_only bulk) -> TypeError on partial bulk failure (inherited Google bug, now a clean RuntimeError)
BE: get_metadata caught only KeyError -> ES NotFoundError leaked into agent tools before first index
BE: stale-resume watchdog claim-and-skip looped forever on unsupported types (incl. llm_routing_faq) -> now marks a terminal error

BE: parser — fenced '#' lines hijacked titles and corrupted content; marker-in-fence/multi-marker split lost body; BOM defeated frontmatter; YAML non-string scalars (reference: 1.10 -> '1.1') mangled anchors or dropped files; indented first content line stripped; humanize lowercased inner caps; empty articles indexed; frontmatter '---' inside block scalars closed early
BE: normalize_faq_path holes ('/'/'a//b'/'/faq'/'faq\sub'/empty -> whole-repo or dead prefixes) -> hardened + 422 on degenerate paths at create

BE: prefix-collision references (a, a-b) silently double-fetched by startswith routing -> warned; IndexTypeByContextTypeMapping.KNOWLEDGE_BASE now lists llm_routing_faq; local clone cleanup wired into FAQ delete; /v1/index/knowledge_base/faq/reindex route added (FE Full Reindex was calling it -> 404)
FE: metadata-only edit always sent link/branch/faq_path -> BE 422 on every plain Save; source fields now sent only with reindex
FE: healthCheckDatasource dropped git_url -> FAQ creation silently blocked in UI; now passed through
FE: faqPath fallback mismatch ('faq/' vs 'faq') -> unified; name now lowercased on create (SDK parity); faqPath regex rejects leading slash
SDK node: update mapper defaulted faq_path -> 422; default removed (BE defaults)
SDK python: no typed FAQ update (create model forced link/branch -> 422); UpdateFaqDataSourceRequest added
accepted_caveats_documented: progress counted before bulk (inherited; now moot — partial bulk raises)
_meta read-merge-write not cross-process serialized (global semaphore only; REST path takes no advisory lock)
delete-before-clone on scheduled reindex: transient auth failure wipes the ES index (pre-existing reprocess design)
setting_id cannot be cleared to anonymous once set; _read_chapters 1000-doc cap; embedding_model on FAQ update ignored

verification.unit: BE: 47 parser + 10 loader + FAQ suites green; FE: typecheck clean + tests; node: 24 mapper tests; python: round-trips verified
verification.regression: BE 1335 passed; 5 failures pre-existing environmental (mime x4 + multiprocessing x1) — both classes verified failing identically on clean main worktrees
verification.live: E2E smoke re-run against local PG+ES: PASSED
